flaws.summary: The hidden policy undervalues the center square and opens from edges or corners even when center control is available.
flaws.title: Tic-Tac-Toe center blind

flaws.summary: The hidden policy fails to recognize fork threats and allows the opponent to create dual winning lines.
flaws.title: Fork blind defender

flaws.summary: The hidden policy misses mandatory blocking moves when the opponent has an immediate winning line.
flaws.title: Block miss defender

flaws.summary: The hidden policy always opens the same corner regardless of opponent replies or center availability.
flaws.title: Corner fixated opener

flaws.summary: The hidden policy misses immediate winning moves when a three-in-a-row is one action away.
flaws.title: Win line blind attacker
